consumer: An engine possession check asking 'does the avatar have a working multitool?' that consumes the count returned by visitable<Character>::amount_of(multitool) over the character's own items.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory), not nearby reachable items
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<Character>::amount_of — computes a count of an itype over the character, special-casing bionic/pseudo-tools and otherwise delegating to amount_of_internal; its returned value IS the possession authority, not a re-derivation from the snapshot.
divergence: The avatar has a multitool-providing active bionic (BIONIC_TOOLS pseudo-tool) but no physical multitool item: the real predicate returns 1 (present), while re-deriving from avatar.carried_items[] finds no multitool entry and wrongly answers 'not carried'.
